integrity: Exact proof based on parity transfer and tensor characteristic polynomials; executable standard-library verification with independent bounded exhaustive checks. All reported tests succeeded; bounded checks do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed simple cycles with at least three vertices; two equally probable independent conformist/rebel types; binary actions; ties allowed. The theorem gives exact first and second moments and relative-variance asymptotics, not full probability laws or general-graph results. Related older random-network statistical-mechanics work was not available in full, leaving publication-priority risk.
title: Exact equilibrium-multiplicity moments on binary fashion-game cycles
